description: Read a program's Architecture tab model (`GET /programs/{programId}/architecture`): `currentVersion` (0 when no architecture has been saved yet, with `body: null` and an explanatory `message`), the structured `body` (summary, principles, decisions, stakeholders, valueStreams, capabilities, informationDomains, applications, integrations, impacts, states, gaps, naSections), version history (`versions`), mapped initiatives, derived coverage/consistency/readiness, `companyCapabilities`, `canEdit`, and `approval` state. Pass `version` to read a specific historical version. Requires `read` scope.

version.description: Optional version number (>= 1) to read instead of the current version.

name: anyforge_get_program_architecture
title: Get program architecture
